Diagnosis.submission: The checkout deployment in the astronomy-shop namespace has a nodeSelector specifying kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node, but no node with that name exists in the cluster (nodes are kind-control-plane, kind-worker, kind-worker2, kind-worker3). This causes all checkout pods to remain in Pending state as they cannot be scheduled on any available node. The fix is to remove the invalid nodeSelector from the checkout deployment so pods can be scheduled on any available worker node.
